title: Anthropology of Sound
description: Examines sound-related dimensions from an anthropological perspective. Draws on ethnographies of listening, sound art works and recent writings in Sound Studies. Experimentation with soundscape production.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of ANTH 303, MDIA 370, MDIA 375.

International students interested in this community-engaged learning course should contact the International Centre for Students (ICS) to discuss potential work authorization requirements for the experiential learning component of this course.
